create.title: Adjacent parity transport and bulk discrete-lattice obstruction
create.statement_tex: Let J=sqrt X, 1<=L<=J^(1/2), and use one representative primitive hard-top orientation a<b=a+2q<4a with one outer 2Re. For every finite zero-extended row, 2 sum_q(-1)^q F_(L,a)(q)=sum_q(-1)^q(F_(L,a)(q)-F_(L,a)(q+1)); this is a signed high-pass identity, not a total-variation or Gram estimate, and truncated sums retain the exact endpoint atom. Put delta_q=sqrt(a+2q)-sqrt a and lambda_q=(delta_q/delta_(q+1))^2. The map T_q(x,k)=(lambda_q x,k/lambda_q) has determinant 1 and preserves the radical phase, kx, and Lambda_q/k. For any fixed compact cardinal extension H, the exact pulled-back sampler is lambda_q sum_n H(lambda_q n)-sum_n H(n)=sum_r(Hhat(r/lambda_q)-Hhat(r)). On every positive common interval of length K, the total-variation distance between sum delta_n and lambda_q sum delta_(lambda_q n) is asymp K for every lambda_q!=1, whether rational or irrational. In a noncollapsed block a asymp A, q asymp D, g asymp L/A, K asymp JD/A, the reciprocal endpoint slabs have width K/D=J/A, the physical pullback slabs have width L/D, the raw lower ceiling jump is (g-chi_4(g(a+2q)))/2, and the exact common-band carrier displacement is Xg(delta_(q+1)^2-delta_q^2)/(4k) asymp JL/A. The coefficient-blind common-comb capacity is DL^2 and the available absolute endpoint capacity is L^2 sqrt(kappa), kappa=JD/(AL)>=D. Hence closeness lambda_q=1+O(1/D), continuous Jacobians, boundary-only decompositions, integer rounding, total variation, and perturbative transport do not supply a polynomial D-saving. A literal first-failure Boolean partition owns simultaneous zero-extension, coprimality, lift, ceiling, reciprocal-support, collar, floor, star, entry/exit, terminal, puncture, and metric-centre jumps exactly once. This is a scoped route obstruction only: it proves no lower bound for the actual signed Vaaler/profile vector and no strict polynomial subrange. The smallest open object is the actual signed common-band scaled-comb correlation, kept jointly with its support and arithmetic slabs when needed. No hard-cone theorem, smooth M2 packet, M9 component, endpoint theorem, or exponent follows.

reject.reason: The parity vector is an eigenvector of the adjacent difference with eigenvalue 2; the high-pass is an exact reformulation and can amplify arbitrary alternating rows.
For every lambda different from 1, rational or irrational, the total-variation distance of the integer and pulled-back scaled combs on a K-interval is comparable with K, not K times |1-lambda|.
The two-dimensional transport has determinant 1, and the one-dimensional x-Jacobian is canceled exactly by the changed density of the pulled-back k-comb.
The exact Poisson identity retains every common-band scaled-comb frequency; replacing it by the symmetric difference of reciprocal intervals drops a bulk term.
Reciprocal endpoints move by J/A and physical supports by L/D, crossing L/D accepted curvature widths; these atoms are not uniformly fixed collars.
Rounding k/lambda to an integer destroys exact kx preservation and leaves a bounded frequency error multiplied by the full physical variable.
The unwrapped increment is of size JL/A, but square, Pell, fourth-power and near-centre configurations can make it integral or nearly integral.
Total variation is attained only after a coefficient-blind phase-conjugating choice. The actual signed Vaaler/profile vector may still cancel before absolute values.
The common-comb capacity loses D and the separate endpoint majorant loses at least D^(1/2); no fixed positive-power D-range is proved.
